presentation_scope: offscreen 100-percent-resolution viewport plus scaled window blit; engine callback intervals, not OS present timing

scene.far_tile_replacement_scope: bounded render attachment of identical canonical geometry; no disk/GIS/contact streaming

unmeasured_targets: Windows displayed frame pacing and end-to-end input latency
final cockpit readability and real-region VRAM residency
production streaming, temporal weather and world-space particles
